18  async def get_current_principal(
   19      request: Request,
   20      session: AsyncSession = db_session_dependency,
   21  ) -> PrincipalContext:
   22      authorization = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
   23      scheme, _, token = authorization.partition(" ")
   24      if scheme.lower() != "bearer" or not token:
   25          raise AgentHubError("AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED", "Authentication is required.", 401)
   26  
   27      settings: Settings = request.app.state.settings
   28      try:
   29          claims = decode_access_token(token, settings)
   30          user_id = UUID(str(claims["sub"]))
   31      except ExpiredAccessToken as exc:
   32          raise AgentHubError("ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED", "Access token has expired.", 401) from exc
   33      except (InvalidAccessToken, ValueError) as exc:
   34          raise AgentHubError("INVALID_ACCESS_TOKEN", "Access token is invalid.", 401) from exc
   35  
   36      user = await SqlAlchemyUserRepository(session).get_by_id(user_id)
   37      if user is None or not user.is_active:
   38          raise AgentHubError("AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED", "Authentication is required.", 401)
   39      return PrincipalContext(
   40          request_id=request.state.request_id,
   41          trace_id=getattr(request.state, "trace_id", request.state.request_id),
   42          user_id=str(user.id),
   43      )

24  async def run_execution_lease(factory, workspace_id, run_id, *, allowed_statuses):
   25      token = uuid4().hex
   26      claimed = False
   27      async with factory() as session:
   28          run = await session.scalar(
   29              select(AgentRun)
   30              .where(AgentRun.workspace_id == workspace_id, AgentRun.id == run_id)
   31              .with_for_update()
   32          )
   33          if run is None:
   34              raise AgentHubError("AGENT_RUN_NOT_FOUND", "The agent run was not found.", 404)
   35          now = datetime.now(UTC)
   36          if run.status in allowed_statuses:
   37              if run.execution_owner:
   38                  if not _live(run.execution_lease_expires_at, now):
   39                      run.status = "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
   40                      run.event_log_complete = False
   41                      run.failure_code = "RUN_EXECUTION_LEASE_EXPIRED"
   42                      run.completed_at = now
   43                      run.execution_owner = None
   44                      run.execution_lease_expires_at = None
   45              else:
   46                  run.execution_owner = token
   47                  run.execution_lease_expires_at = now + timedelta(seconds=LEASE_SECONDS)
   48                  claimed = True
   49          await session.commit()
   50      if not claimed:
   51          yield None
   52          return
   53      owner_task = asyncio.current_task()
   54      lost = False
   55  
   56      async def renew():
   57          nonlocal lost
   58          while True:
   59              await asyncio.sleep(RENEW_SECONDS)
   60              try:
   61                  async with factory() as session:
   62                      result = await session.execute(
   63                          update(AgentRun)
   64                          .where(
   65                              AgentRun.workspace_id == workspace_id,
   66                              AgentRun.id == run_id,
   67                              AgentRun.execution_owner == token,
   68                              AgentRun.execution_lease_expires_at > func.now(),
   69                          )
   70                          .values(
   71                              execution_lease_expires_at=datetime.now(UTC)
   72                              + timedelta(seconds=LEASE_SECONDS)
   73                          )
   74                      )
   75                      await session.commit()
   76                      if result.rowcount == 1:
   77                          continue
   78              except Exception:
   79                  pass
   80              lost = True
   81              try:
   82                  async with factory() as session:
   83                      await session.execute(
   84                          update(AgentRun)
   85                          .where(
   86                              AgentRun.workspace_id == workspace_id,
   87                              AgentRun.id == run_id,
   88                              AgentRun.execution_owner == token,
   89                          )
   90                          .values(
   91                              status="NEEDS_ATTENTION",
   92                              event_log_complete=False,
   93                              failure_code="RUN_EXECUTION_LEASE_LOST",
   94                              completed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
   95                          )
   96                      )
   97                      await session.commit()
   98              except Exception:
   99                  # Leave the lease in place: the next claimant must fence the
  100                  # expired owner to NEEDS_ATTENTION, never re-execute the graph.
  101                  pass
  102              owner_task.cancel()
  103              return
  104  
  105      renewal = asyncio.create_task(renew())
  106      try:
  107          yield token
  108      except asyncio.CancelledError:
  109          if not lost:
  110              # Process/request cancellation can interrupt a claimed action.
  111              # Preserve a reconciliation marker before releasing ownership.
  112              async with factory() as session:
  113                  await session.execute(
  114                      update(AgentRun)
  115                      .where(
  116                          AgentRun.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  117                          AgentRun.id == run_id,
  118                          AgentRun.execution_owner == token,
  119                          AgentRun.status.in_({"RUNNING", "CANCEL_REQUESTED"}),
  120                      )
  121                      .values(
  122                          status="NEEDS_ATTENTION",
  123                          event_log_complete=False,
  124                          failure_code="RUN_EXECUTION_INTERRUPTED",
  125                          completed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
  126                      )
  127                  )
  128                  await session.commit()
  129          if lost:
  130              raise AgentHubError(
  131                  "RUN_EXECUTION_LEASE_LOST",
  132                  "Run ownership was lost; reconciliation is required.",
  133                  409,
  134              ) from None
  135          raise
  136      except BaseException:
  137          async with factory() as session:
  138              await session.execute(
  139                  update(AgentRun)
  140                  .where(
  141                      AgentRun.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  142                      AgentRun.id == run_id,
  143                      AgentRun.execution_owner == token,
  144                      AgentRun.status.in_({"RUNNING", "CANCEL_REQUESTED"}),
  145                  )
  146                  .values(
  147                      status="NEEDS_ATTENTION",
  148                      event_log_complete=False,
  149                      failure_code="RUN_EXECUTION_INTERRUPTED",
  150                      completed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
  151                  )
  152              )
  153              await session.commit()
  154          raise
  155      finally:
  156          renewal.cancel()
  157          with suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
  158              await renewal
  159          # A newer owner/maintenance transition cannot be cleared by this worker.
  160          async with factory() as session:
  161              await session.execute(
  162                  update(AgentRun)
  163                  .where(
  164                      AgentRun.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  165                      AgentRun.id == run_id,
  166                      AgentRun.execution_owner == token,
  167                  )
  168                  .values(
  169                      execution_owner=None,
  170                      execution_lease_expires_at=None,
  171                      event_log_complete=case(
  172                          (AgentRun.status.in_({"RUNNING", "CANCEL_REQUESTED"}), False),
  173                          else_=AgentRun.event_log_complete,
  174                      ),
  175                      # Release and nonterminal fencing form one transaction.
  176                      # RUNNING with no owner must remain a safe-to-start draft,
  177                      # never a partially executed graph whose error write failed.
  178                      status=case(
  179                          (AgentRun.status.in_({"RUNNING", "CANCEL_REQUESTED"}), "NEEDS_ATTENTION"),
  180                          else_=AgentRun.status,
  181                      ),
  182                      failure_code=case(
  183                          (
  184                              AgentRun.status.in_({"RUNNING", "CANCEL_REQUESTED"}),
  185                              "RUN_EXECUTION_INTERRUPTED",
  186                          ),
  187                          else_=AgentRun.failure_code,
  188                      ),
  189                      completed_at=case(
  190                          (AgentRun.status.in_({"RUNNING", "CANCEL_REQUESTED"}), datetime.now(UTC)),
  191                          else_=AgentRun.completed_at,
  192                      ),
  193                  )
  194              )
  195              await session.commit()

533      def admit(
  534          self,
  535          messages: Sequence[ModelMessage | ContextMessage] = (),
  536          categories: Sequence[ContextCategory] | Mapping[int, ContextCategory] | None = None,
  537          exchange_groups: Sequence[Hashable | None] | Mapping[int, Hashable | None] | None = None,
  538          tool_definitions: Sequence[ModelToolDefinition] = (),
  539      ) -> ContextAdmissionResult:
  540          """Return the admitted messages and tools.
  541  
  542          Raw ``ModelMessage`` values require parallel ``categories`` and may
  543          optionally receive parallel ``exchange_groups``.  Alternatively,
  544          callers can pass ``ContextMessage`` values, which carry both pieces of
  545          metadata inline.  No category is inferred from message text, roles, or
  546          tool names.
  547          """
  548  
  549          normalized = self._normalize_messages(messages, categories, exchange_groups)
  550          memory_payloads = self._validate_memory_payloads(normalized)
  551          tools = tuple(tool_definitions)
  552          if any(not isinstance(tool, ModelToolDefinition) for tool in tools):
  553              raise TypeError("tool_definitions must contain ModelToolDefinition values")
  554          return self._admit_normalized(normalized, tools, memory_payloads)

1  """Small LangGraph adapter boundary for the provider-neutral runtime."""
    2  
    3  from __future__ import annotations
    4  
    5  from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
    6  from typing import Any
    7  
    8  from langgraph.graph import END, START, StateGraph
    9  from langgraph.types import Command, interrupt
   10  
   11  
   12  def resume_command(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Any:
   13      return Command(resume=dict(payload))
   14  
   15  
   16  def approval_interrupt(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Any:
   17      return interrupt(dict(payload))
   18  
   19  
   20  def interrupt_payloads(state: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]:
   21      interrupts = state.get("__interrupt__")
   22      if not interrupts:
   23          return ()
   24      if not isinstance(interrupts, (list, tuple)):
   25          interrupts = (interrupts,)
   26      payloads: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   27      for item in interrupts:
   28          value = getattr(item, "value", item)
   29          if isinstance(value, Mapping):
   30              payloads.append(dict(value))
   31      return tuple(payloads)
   32  
   33  
   34  def compile_agent_graph(
   35      state_type: type,
   36      *,
   37      nodes: Mapping[str, Callable[..., Any]],
   38      edges: Sequence[tuple[str, str]],
   39      conditional_edges: Mapping[str, Callable[..., Any]],
   40      checkpointer: Any | None = None,
   41  ) -> Any:
   42      graph = StateGraph(state_type)
   43      for name, handler in nodes.items():
   44          graph.add_node(name, handler)
   45      for source, target in edges:
   46          graph.add_edge(
   47              START if source == "__START__" else source,
   48              END if target == "__END__" else target,
   49          )
   50      for source, router in conditional_edges.items():
   51          graph.add_conditional_edges(source, router)
   52      return graph.compile(checkpointer=checkpointer)
   53  
   54  
   55  __all__ = [
   56      "approval_interrupt",
   57      "compile_agent_graph",
   58      "interrupt_payloads",
   59      "resume_command",
   60  ]

1  """Evidence-preserving Wiki query routing.
    2  
    3  This module composes the published Wiki projection with the existing raw
    4  retriever.  It deliberately performs extractive retrieval only: no model is
    5  called and a page summary is never presented as the answer.
    6  """
    7  
    8  from __future__ import annotations
    9  
   10  import json
   11  import re
   12  from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable, Mapping, Sequence
   13  from typing import Any, Protocol
   14  from uuid import UUID
   15  
   16  from sqlalchemy import and_, select
   17  
   18  from packages.core.errors.exceptions import AgentHubError
   19  from packages.core.execution_context.models import WorkspaceExecutionContext
   20  from packages.knowledge.contracts import RetrievalQuery
   21  from packages.knowledge.models import DocumentChunk, KnowledgeSnapshotItem
   22  from packages.wiki.evidence_envelope import (
   23      EVIDENCE_ORIGIN_RAW,
   24      stamp_wiki_derived_evidence,
   25  )
   26  from packages.wiki.models import WikiSourceRevocation
   27  
   28  _MODES = frozenset({"WIKI", "RAG", "HYBRID", "AUTO"})
   29  _INTENTS = frozenset({"overview", "fact", "synthesis"})
   30  _WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[^\W_]+", re.UNICODE)
   31  _TOKEN_PART_RE = re.compile(
   32      r"[\u3400-\u4dbf\u4e00-\u9fff\uf900-\ufaff]+|[^\u3400-\u4dbf\u4e00-\u9fff\uf900-\ufaff]+"
   33  )
   34  _HAN_RE = re.compile(r"[\u3400-\u4dbf\u4e00-\u9fff\uf900-\ufaff]")
   35  _WHITESPACE_RE = re.compile(r"\s+")
   36  
   37  _EMPTY_QUERY_ANSWER = "The query must not be empty."
   38  _INSUFFICIENT_ANSWER = "Insufficient evidence to answer from the selected knowledge binding."
   39  _CONFLICT_ANSWER = "Conflicting evidence prevents a safe extractive answer."
   40  
   41  
   42  class WikiServiceProtocol(Protocol):
   43      async def validate_binding(
   44          self,
   45          session: Any,
   46          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
   47          kb_id: UUID | str,
   48          compilation_id: UUID | str,
   49          source_snapshot_id: UUID | str,
   50          require_current: bool = True,
   51      ) -> Any: ...
   52  
   53      async def pages(
   54          self,
   55          session: Any,
   56          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
   57          kb_id: UUID | str,
   58          compilation_id: UUID | str,
   59      ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]: ...
   60  
   61  
   62  PageLoader = Callable[
   63      [Any, WorkspaceExecutionContext, UUID, UUID],
   64      Awaitable[list[dict[str, Any]]],
   65  ]
   66  
   67  
   68  def _normalize(text: str) -> str:
   69      return _WHITESPACE_RE.sub(" ", text.casefold()).strip()
   70  
   71  
   72  def _tokens(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
   73      """Tokenize Latin words and Han bigrams for conservative title matching."""
   74  
   75      tokens: list[str] = []
   76      for word in _WORD_RE.findall(text.casefold()):
   77          for part in _TOKEN_PART_RE.findall(word):
   78              if _HAN_RE.fullmatch(part[0]):
   79                  if len(part) == 1:
   80                      tokens.append(part)
   81                  else:
   82                      tokens.extend(part[index : index + 2] for index in range(len(part) - 1))
   83              else:
   84                  tokens.append(part)
   85      return tuple(dict.fromkeys(tokens))
   86  
   87  
   88  def _page_match_score(query: str, title: str) -> float:
   89      normalized_query = _normalize(query)
   90      normalized_title = _normalize(title)
   91      if not normalized_query or not normalized_title:
   92          return 0.0
   93      if normalized_query == normalized_title:
   94          return 1.0
   95  
   96      query_tokens = set(_tokens(normalized_query))
   97      title_tokens = set(_tokens(normalized_title))
   98      if not query_tokens or not title_tokens:
   99          return 0.0
  100  
  101      # A title phrase contained in a natural-language question is stronger than
  102      # isolated token overlap, but the overlap must still be visible.
  103      if normalized_title in normalized_query:
  104          return 0.9
  105      if normalized_query in normalized_title:
  106          return 0.85
  107  
  108      overlap = query_tokens & title_tokens
  109      if not overlap:
  110          return 0.0
  111      if len(title_tokens) == 1 or len(query_tokens) == 1:
  112          return 0.65 if overlap else 0.0
  113  
  114      title_coverage = len(overlap) / len(title_tokens)
  115      query_coverage = len(overlap) / len(query_tokens)
  116  
  117      if len(overlap) >= 2 and (title_coverage >= 0.35 or query_coverage >= 0.4):
  118          return 0.55 + (0.25 * max(title_coverage, query_coverage))
  119      if len(overlap) == 1 and title_coverage >= 0.5:
  120          return 0.50
  121      return 0.0
  122  
  123  
  124  def _matched_pages(query: str, pages: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  125      ranked: list[tuple[float, str, dict[str, Any]]] = []
  126      seen: set[str] = set()
  127      for candidate in pages:
  128          page = dict(candidate)
  129          page_key = str(page.get("page_key", ""))
  130          if not page_key or page_key in seen:
  131              continue
  132          score = _page_match_score(query, str(page.get("title", "")))
  133          if score <= 0:
  134              continue
  135          seen.add(page_key)
  136          ranked.append((score, str(page.get("title", "")).casefold(), page))
  137      ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1], str(item[2].get("page_key", ""))))
  138      return [item[2] for item in ranked]
  139  
  140  
  141  def _error(code: str, message: str, status_code: int) -> AgentHubError:
  142      return AgentHubError(code, message, status_code)
  143  
  144  
  145  def _uuid(value: UUID | str, *, field: str, client_input: bool) -> UUID:
  146      try:
  147          return value if isinstance(value, UUID) else UUID(str(value))
  148      except (TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError):
  149          if client_input:
  150              raise _error(
  151                  "INVALID_WIKI_BINDING",
  152                  f"The {field} is invalid.",
  153                  400,
  154              ) from None
  155          raise _error("INVALID_WORKSPACE", "Workspace context is invalid.", 500) from None
  156  
  157  
  158  def _attribute(value: Any, name: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
  159      if isinstance(value, Mapping):
  160          return value.get(name, default)
  161      return getattr(value, name, default)
  162  
  163  
  164  def _same_uuid(value: Any, expected: UUID) -> bool:
  165      try:
  166          return UUID(str(value)) == expected
  167      except (TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError):
  168          return False
  169  
  170  
  171  def _default_service() -> WikiServiceProtocol:
  172      from packages.wiki.service import WikiService
  173  
  174      return WikiService()
  175  
  176  
  177  def _binding(
  178      compilation: Any,
  179      *,
  180      workspace_id: UUID,

1  """Provider-neutral production trace sink with redacted structured logging."""
    2  
    3  from __future__ import annotations
    4  
    5  import logging
    6  import time
    7  from collections.abc import Mapping
    8  from typing import Any
    9  
   10  from packages.observability.contracts import TraceSpan
   11  
   12  logger = logging.getLogger("agenthub.observability")
   13  _REDACTED_KEY_PARTS = ("prompt", "content", "credential", "secret", "password", "argument")
   14  
   15  
   16  def _safe_attributes(attributes: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
   17      result: dict[str, Any] = {}
   18      for key, value in (attributes or {}).items():
   19          normalized = str(key).lower()
   20          if any(part in normalized for part in _REDACTED_KEY_PARTS):
   21              continue
   22          if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)) or value is None:
   23              result[str(key)] = value
   24          elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
   25              result[str(key)] = [str(item) for item in value[:32]]
   26      return result
   27  
   28  
   29  class SafeTraceSpan:
   30      def __init__(self, name: str, attributes: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> None:
   31          self.name = name
   32          self.attributes = _safe_attributes(attributes)
